h1: Shopify speed check, finding what slows your store
overview: We test your home, collection and product pages on phone and desktop, then show you in plain words what holds them back. Usual causes are heavy images, apps that load on every page, unused fonts and large sliders. We fix the safe ones in your theme, remove or delay what you do not need, and test again so you can see the change in the numbers. We make real, checked improvements and do not promise scores.

faq: Will my speed score reach a set number?

We cannot promise a score, because results depend on your theme, products and apps, and tools like Lighthouse vary from run to run. We give careful work, recorded before and after numbers, and a clear note on what could not be improved.
Never without asking. We list the apps that cost you speed, tell you what each one does for you, and only remove or delay the ones you agree to. Removals are tested on a duplicate theme first.
Yes. We compress and resize images to sensible dimensions, keep the originals safe, and make sure they still look sharp. Product photos get extra care so the quality your buyers see does not drop.
Is this a one-off, or does speed need upkeep?
Stores slow down again as apps and images are added. This sprint resets the baseline and gives you a short rulebook for keeping it fast. A regular check can be quoted as a monthly service.
